script.goal: One clear next step for this call.
script.opener: Who you are, why you are calling (inbound or cold), permission, one question.

items: Which services bring in most of your work: kids' parties, marquees, cocktail bars, weddings?
What are your busiest months, and what are you booking now (Christmas, New Year)?
Which areas do you really cover?
About how many enquiries do you get a month, and which ones pay best?
How do people find you today?
When an enquiry comes in, how do you reply and how fast?
About how many turn into bookings?
Do you get reviews, and where?
What does growth mean for you in numbers (bookings a month)?
What have you tried so far (ads, social, directories)?
What would feel comfortable as a one-off amount, or a monthly one?
Who built the website, and who has the hosting and domain logins?
Do you see how many people visit, or where they come from?
Are you on Facebook or Instagram for the business?
Do you have photos from real events and any reviews we could use?
Do you have set prices or packages, and public liability insurance?

objections: That's why we have a one-off Starter: fixed price, split in two, and you own the site. We can start with just the basics. (Confirm the price first.)
You do, and it's a good base. The gaps are small: tap-to-call, titles, reviews and tracking. We can look together at whether to fix it or rebuild.
Great. I can send you the list of what we found so you can compare, free of charge.
Happy to. So I send the right thing: is it more enquiries you need, or less time chasing them?
It's a busy time of year.
Understood. A 15-minute check is enough for now. When is a better week?
How did you get my number?
From the form you filled in on [date and source]. I can remove it if you'd prefer.
script.close: "Could we do a 15-minute screen share this week, where I show you the three things on your own site and we decide whether a proper plan is worth it?"
script.followup: Same day. Thank her for her time, recap the three points we discussed, give the booking link for the 15-minute check, and say there is no obligation. Do not attach prices unless she asked.
